accepted_limitations: 1 pull request records are excluded from working issues and retained as raw source records.
Closed GitHub issues stay visible in the Closed list and are not archived. Issue closure does not infer due-date completion.
GitHub API pages form a non-atomic snapshot. Issues, users, labels, and comments may have changed between requests; repository completeness cannot be guaranteed.
Issue events, reactions, linked projects, attachment file contents, and histories not included in the snapshot are not imported or reconstructed.
Milestones, issue type, parent data when supplied, creation/update/closure dates, and unknown GitHub keys remain read-only source fields. Milestone dates are not treated as issue deadlines.
Missing or null optional text is retained in raw provenance and source fields; the working schema may represent it as an empty string.
The collected snapshot file is preserved byte-for-byte. Its parsed HTTP JSON values do not establish whitespace-identical preservation of the original HTTP wire bodies.
